invariants: Portal cannot create or mutate authoritative payment state
Portal cannot mark PAID without verified provider/backend evidence
Portal cannot mark BUILD complete from UI-only state
Portal cannot mark QA passed without QA evidence
Portal cannot mark UAT accepted without customer acceptance evidence
Portal cannot mark DELIVERY complete without delivery evidence
Portal cannot infer Production deployment from factory success
Unknown, stale or contradictory source state must render HOLD or REVIEW
Customer may only see records bound to their authorized customer account/project
Portal actions that mutate commercial or project state require separately approved gated workflows
